title: Approve template-driven ProvisionTable architecture (WP-M2-06)
summary: The schema-first review page is now the only render path. It currently has provision cards, but the old review page also had structured analytical tables for conditions, interim covenants, no-shop, employee benefits, SEC meeting, no-other-reps/fraud, and consideration. WP-M2-06 proposes one generic ProvisionTable template driven by table config objects, with configs reading from schema cards and reusing existing table-logic helpers. Approving lets Codex port each table family back into the schema-first page without recreating one bespoke React component per table.
